blocks.text: Glass calorimeter solution mein reactions ke liye munasib hai magar gases wali reactions ke liye nahi, jo nikal jatin, na un ke liye jin ke products bohat garam hon. Yeh beaker, stirrer, thermometer aur dheeli lid par mushtamil hai jo contents ko hawai dabao par rakhti hai; beaker ka bahar rui (cotton wool) se insulate kiya jata hai taake hawa se hararat ka tabadla kam se kam ho. Reaction beaker mein ki jati hai aur kharij ya jazb hararat darja hararat ki tabdeeli se napi jati hai; kyunke dabao mustaqil hai, darja hararat ki paimaish enthalpy tabdeeli deti hai. Kharij sari hararat calorimeter mein rehti aur pani jazb karta hai, to q = m(pani) x c(pani) x delta T; kJ ke liye 1000 se taqseem karein; phir exothermic reaction ke liye delta H = -q / n = -m c delta T / n kJ fi mol, jahan n moles ki tadaad hai. Solutions itne patle hain ke un ka taqreeban sara mass pani hai, to pani ki specific heat istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: gaddedar jacket ke andar beaker jis mein dheeli lid se thermometer aur stirrer guzarte hain, hisse label-shuda, aur q = m c delta T aur delta H = -q / n ka dabba. Daen: narangi dabba 0.5 molar NaOH aur HCl ki neutralization ko paanch numbered qadmon mein hal karta hai, aur neela dabba glucose ka calorie content deta hai.
blocks.caption: Glass calorimeter, hararat ka muadla aur hal shuda neutralization aur calorie hisabat (Figure 6.3 aur Sample Problem 6.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Beaker patla reaction mixture rakhta hai, insulated taake kharij hararat sirf solution ko garam kare; thermometer delta T deta hai, aur q = m c delta T hararat deta hai. React hone wale moles se taqseem aur manfi nishan laga kar delta H milta hai. 0.5 molar NaOH aur HCl ke 100 cm3 har ek ke liye 200 g mixture 3.5 K garam hota hai, 0.05 mol pani ke liye 2.94 kJ kharij karte hue, to delta Hn = -58.8 kJ fi mol, kisi bhi strong acid aur alkali ke liye mutawaqqa -57.1 ke qareeb. Neeche ka dabba glucose ke -2803 kJ fi mol ko 15.57 kJ fi g aur 3.72 kcal fi g banata dikhata hai.

blocks.caption: Sample Problem 6.2: 100 cm3 0.5 mol/dm3 NaOH ki 100 cm3 0.5 mol/dm3 HCl se neutralization

blocks.prompt: 50 cm3 HNO3 50 cm3 1.5 mol/dm3 NaOH se react karta hai aur darja hararat 4 degrees C barhta hai. Delta Hn nikalein (acid ko kam se kam barabar miqdar mein lein).
blocks.explanation: Solution ka mass taqreeban 100 g; q = 100 x 4.2 x 4 = 1680 J = 1.68 kJ. Pani ke moles = NaOH ke moles = 1.5 x 0.050 = 0.075 mol. Print ke data se delta Hn = -1.68 / 0.075 = -22.4 kJ fi mol, mutawaqqa -57.1 se kahin kam; chhape hue adaad (hajm aur darja hararat ka izafa) mukammal strong acid-base neutralization se mel nahi khate.

items: Glass calorimeter: beaker, stirrer, thermometer, dheeli lid, rui; solutions ke liye, gases ya bohat garam products ke liye nahi; patle solutions ke liye pani ki specific heat se delta H = -m c delta T / n.
Sample 6.2: 200 g 3.5 K garam, q = 2.94 kJ, 0.05 mol pani, delta Hn = -58.8 kJ fi mol.
